description: 20-question text-to-SQL benchmark. Full mode compares generated vs golden SQL result sets (execution accuracy). Offline mode only runs the safety gate against malicious SQL.

questions.question: Top 5 cities by revenue
questions.golden_sql: SELECT c.city, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price),2) t FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status!='cancelled' GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: How many orders were placed in 2025?
questions.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date LIKE '2025%'

questions.question: Best-selling product by total quantity
questions.golden_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) q FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY q DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Revenue per product category
questions.golden_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price),2) r FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY r DESC

questions.question: How many customers are in each city?
questions.golden_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

questions.question: Average order value in 2025
questions.golden_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(t),2) FROM (SELECT o.id, SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price) t FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id GROUP BY o.id)

questions.question: Top 3 customers by total spend
questions.golden_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price),2) s FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: Number of cancelled orders in 2025
questions.golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status='cancelled'

questions.question: Most expensive product name and price
questions.golden_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Products in the Electronics category with price under 100
questions.golden_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE category='Electronics' AND price < 100

questions.question: Monthly revenue trend in 2025
questions.golden_sql: SELECT substr(o.order_date,1,7) m, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price),2) r FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id GROUP BY m ORDER BY m

questions.question: How many items are in each order on average?
questions.golden_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(c),2) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)

questions.question: Which customers signed up in Mumbai?
questions.golden_sql: SELECT name, signup_date FROM customers WHERE city='Mumbai' ORDER BY signup_date

questions.question: Percentage of orders that were delivered
questions.golden_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN status='delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) FROM orders

questions.question: Products that were never ordered
questions.golden_sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id=p.id WHERE oi.id IS NULL

questions.question: Top 2 cities by number of orders
questions.golden_sql: SELECT c.city, COUNT(*) n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 2

questions.question: Total quantity sold for each fitness product
questions.golden_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) q FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id WHERE p.category='Fitness' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY q DESC

questions.question: Distinct order statuses
questions.golden_sql: SELECT DISTINCT status FROM orders

questions.question: Customer with the earliest signup date
questions.golden_sql: SELECT name, signup_date FROM customers ORDER BY signup_date LIMIT 1

questions.question: Revenue by city including cancelled orders
questions.golden_sql: SELECT c.city, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price),2) r FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY r DESC
